why_choose_us.title: Why Choose us ?
why_choose_us.description: At France AJ Alimentaire And Food LTDA, we take pride in being a reliable and trusted partner in the global food and commodity supply chain. Our expertise spans across diverse products including sugar, soybeans, corn, corn animal feed, sunflower oil, soybean oil, chicken, beef, and lamb. Here are six key reasons to partner with us:

reasons.title: Proven Global Export Expertise
reasons.description: With years of experience in the international sugar trade, we've built a strong reputation for reliability, integrity, and quality. Our extensive network spans across Asia, Europe, Africa, and the Americas — allowing us to serve a diverse range of clients with confidence and professionalism. Whether you are a wholesaler, distributor, or food manufacturer, we understand your market needs and deliver with precision.

reasons.title: Direct Sourcing from Certified Producers
reasons.description: We work directly with trusted sugar mills and refineries, ensuring full control over quality, pricing, and consistency. By cutting out intermediaries, we’re able to offer competitive rates while maintaining full transparency in our sourcing process. Our supply partners are vetted for compliance with global safety and quality standards, and many hold certifications such as ISO 9001, HACCP, and GMP.

reasons.title: Uncompromising Quality & Compliance
reasons.description: Quality is our core promise. All our sugar products — whether raw, white refined, or specialty-grade — undergo strict quality control procedures before export. We adhere to international food safety regulations and can provide lab-tested results and certifications upon request. Our quality assurance team monitors every step of the process, from production to packaging to port delivery.

reasons.title: Tailored Packaging & Logistics Solutions
reasons.description: Every market is different, and so are your packaging requirements. That’s why we offer flexible packaging options for a wide range of products, designed to meet your specific needs. Our logistics team ensures that every shipment is professionally packed, labeled, and delivered on time, no matter your location. From small retail packs to bulk containers, we handle the details so you can focus on growing your business.

reasons.title: Reliable, On-Time Delivery – Every Time
reasons.description: Delays can cost you business. That’s why we focus on building a robust and responsive supply chain. From port operations to customs documentation, we handle the complexities so you don’t have to. With real-time tracking, proactive communication, and dependable freight partners, we guarantee timely deliveries that keep your operations running smoothly.

reasons.title: Long-Term Partnerships You Can Trust
reasons.description: We’re not just here for a single shipment — we’re here to build lasting relationships. Our clients value our consistent service, transparent communication, and willingness to go the extra mile. With flexible contract options, responsive support, and a dedication to helping your business grow, we aim to be your long-term export partner.

about_page.about_ecoland_header: Delivering Quality from Brazil to the World
about_page.about_ecoland_header_desc:
At France AJ Alimentaire And Food LTDA, we take pride in being a reliable link between Brazil’s rich agricultural production and global markets across Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Middle East. We specialize in the export of high-quality food commodities — including grains, oils, sugar, and frozen meats — that meet the highest international standards for safety, consistency, and freshness. 

 With over three decades of experience in the food trade industry, our team understands the complexities of global sourcing, compliance, and logistics. We leverage this deep expertise to ensure every shipment is delivered efficiently, on time, and in perfect condition — whether it's a single container or a full-scale recurring supply contract. 

 As a proud subsidiary of the France AJ Group, our Brazil division is committed to upholding the group’s legacy of excellence. Our mission is simple yet powerful: To provide global partners with food products that are not only safe and competitively priced, but ethically sourced and sustainably delivered. 

 From agricultural fields in Brazil to warehouses across continents, France AJ Alimentaire And Food LTDA is a name you can trust — rooted in quality, driven by values, and focused on your business success.

about_page.header_one_desc: With deep roots in Brazil and over 30 years in international trade, we combine local sourcing strength with global logistics know-how to deliver smooth, reliable cross-border shipments.
about_page.header_two_desc: We build long-term relationships through integrity and transparency. From your first inquiry to final delivery, our team is committed to clear communication and personalized support.
about_page.header_three_desc: All products are sourced from certified suppliers and undergo rigorous quality control before export — including lab testing, inspection, and full documentation to meet international food safety standards.

about_page.business_activity_value: Wholesale Export & Import of Food Commodities — Grains, Edible Oils, Sugar, Frozen Proteins (HALAL)
about_page.how_we_work_subtitle: Our end-to-end trading process is transparent, structured, and designed to give buyers full confidence — from the first inquiry to final delivery.
about_page.step_1_desc: The buyer submits a Request for Quotation (RFQ) or Letter of Intent (LOI) specifying the product, quantity, destination, and preferred terms.
about_page.step_2_desc: Our trade team reviews the inquiry, verifies product availability, and assesses the buyer requirements before proceeding.
about_page.step_3_desc: We issue a full and firm Quotation or Full Corporate Offer (FCO) detailing product specifications, pricing, payment terms, and delivery conditions.
about_page.step_4_desc: The buyer reviews the FCO and sends confirmation of acceptance or requests further negotiation. Once agreed, the process advances.
about_page.step_5_desc: A formal Sales & Purchase Agreement (SPA) or Contract is drafted and signed by both parties, outlining all trade terms and obligations.
about_page.step_6_desc: The buyer arranges the agreed payment instrument — such as a Letter of Credit (LC), Bank Transfer (TT), or other mutually accepted method.
about_page.step_7_desc: Products undergo pre-shipment inspection by an independent, internationally recognized agency to verify quality, quantity, and specifications.
about_page.step_8_desc: Goods are loaded and dispatched per the agreed Incoterms (FOB, CIF, etc.). Logistics and freight are managed efficiently from port to destination.
about_page.step_9_desc: Complete shipping documentation is prepared and released — including Bill of Lading, Certificate of Origin, Phytosanitary / Health Certificate, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, and HALAL Certificate where applicable.
about_page.payment_terms_subtitle: We support internationally recognized payment and delivery terms to give buyers flexibility and confidence at every stage of the transaction.
about_page.term_fob_desc: The seller delivers goods on board the vessel at the named port of shipment. Risk transfers to the buyer once goods are on board. Freight and insurance from that point are the buyer's responsibility.
about_page.term_cif_desc: The seller covers the cost of the goods, marine insurance, and freight charges to the named destination port. Risk transfers to the buyer upon loading, but the seller arranges and pays for transport.
about_page.term_cnf_desc: The seller is responsible for the cost of goods and ocean freight to the named destination port. Insurance is arranged by the buyer. Similar to CIF, but without the seller covering insurance.
about_page.term_dlc_label: DLC MT700 — Documentary Letter of Credit
about_page.term_dlc_desc: A bank-issued payment guarantee (SWIFT MT700) ensuring the seller receives payment upon presenting compliant shipping documents. Widely used in international commodity trade to mitigate counterparty risk.
about_page.term_sblc_label: SBLC MT760 — Standby Letter of Credit
about_page.term_sblc_desc: A bank-backed standby guarantee (SWIFT MT760) activated only if the buyer fails to fulfill their payment obligations. Applied where contractually required and agreed upon by both parties.
about_page.term_final_desc: All trade terms, payment instruments, delivery schedules, inspection rights, and dispute resolution mechanisms are clearly defined in the signed Sales & Purchase Agreement (SPA), ensuring full legal protection for both parties.
about_page.company_facts_subtitle: The figures below reflect three decades in the international food trade — a specialist team, a network of global offices, and shipments reaching importers, distributors, and manufacturers in more than 50 countries.
about_page.who_we_serve_title: Built for Serious B2B Food Buyers
about_page.who_we_serve_subtitle: From a single trial container to recurring monthly contracts, we supply buyers at every level of the international food supply chain.
about_page.buyer_1_desc: National and regional importers who need consistent volumes, correct documentation, and shipping schedules they can plan around.
about_page.buyer_2_desc: Traders sourcing competitive FOB and CIF offers on grains, sugar, edible oils, and frozen proteins for resale in their own markets.
about_page.buyer_3_desc: Processing plants that require raw material to a fixed specification — grade, moisture, ICUMSA, protein content, and packing format.
about_page.buyer_4_desc: Retail groups and private-label programmes needing retail-ready packing, labelling support, and dependable replenishment cycles.
about_page.buyer_5_desc: Hotels, restaurants, catering groups, and foodservice distributors sourcing HALAL frozen proteins, rice, and edible oils.
about_page.buyer_6_desc: Tender-based and institutional purchasers who require full compliance documentation, inspection rights, and audit-ready paperwork.
about_page.sourcing_title: A Sourcing Network Rooted in Brazil
about_page.sourcing_desc:
Brazil is our primary origin — one of the world's largest producers of sugar, soybeans, corn, poultry, and beef. We work directly with SIF-registered plants, licensed mills, refineries, and cooperatives, which keeps our pricing competitive and our supply stable across the season. 

 Where a buyer's specification or budget is better served by another origin, our multi-origin network lets us present alternatives without compromising on certification, inspection, or delivery terms. Every origin we offer carries the same documentation standard and the same pre-shipment inspection process.
about_page.sourcing_image_alt: Brazilian grain sourcing network — France AJ Alimentaire And Food LTDA | bulk corn, soybean & sugar export origin
about_page.markets_subtitle: Shipments leave Brazilian ports under FOB, CIF, and CFR terms for buyers across four continents — every consignment inspected, documented, and certified for the market it enters.
about_page.market_1_desc: Bulk grains, rice, sugar, and frozen poultry moving to importers and processors across the region.
about_page.market_2_desc: HALAL-certified frozen proteins and ICUMSA 45 sugar, shipped with the certification each market requires.
about_page.market_3_desc: High-volume rice, sugar, edible oils, and poultry supplied against tender and long-term supply contracts.
about_page.market_4_desc: Non-GMO grains, refined oils, and specialty lots for manufacturers working to strict compliance standards.
about_page.mission_statement: To provide global partners with food products that are not only safe and competitively priced, but ethically sourced and sustainably delivered.
about_page.vision_statement: To be the most dependable bridge between Brazilian agriculture and the world's food buyers — measured not by tonnage alone, but by how many partners return contract after contract.
about_page.value_1_desc: Clear offers, honest lead times, and no hidden costs. If a shipment is delayed, you hear it from us first.
about_page.value_2_desc: We would rather decline an order than ship product that fails to meet the contracted specification.
about_page.value_3_desc: Booking, loading, and documentation are managed to the agreed schedule so your own commitments stay intact.
about_page.value_4_desc: We buy from producers who meet recognised labour, environmental, and animal welfare standards.
about_page.value_5_desc: Our business is built on repeat contracts, not one-off deals — so we price and service accounts for the long run.
about_page.value_6_desc: Every document is genuine, verifiable, and issued by the competent authority for the destination market.
about_page.qa_subtitle: Every shipment passes the same controls before it leaves origin — regardless of order size or destination.
about_page.qa_1_desc: We buy only from plants, mills, and refineries holding valid SIF, HALAL, ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, or equivalent approval for the destination market.
about_page.qa_2_desc: Quality, quantity, and packing are verified at loading by an internationally recognised agency such as SGS or Control Union — or one named by the buyer.
about_page.qa_3_desc: Each lot is tested against the contracted specification and released with a Certificate of Analysis covering every agreed parameter.
about_page.qa_4_desc: Frozen proteins are held and shipped at controlled temperature from plant to vessel, with reefer settings recorded throughout the voyage.
about_page.qa_5_desc: Bill of Lading, Certificate of Origin, Phytosanitary or Health Certificate, HALAL Certificate, Commercial Invoice, and Packing List issued for every shipment.
about_page.qa_6_desc: Every consignment traces back to its producing plant, lot number, and production date — essential for customs clearance and recall readiness.
about_page.final_cta_desc: Send us your product, quantity, destination port, and preferred Incoterm. Our trade desk replies with a firm quotation or Full Corporate Offer — usually within one business day.
